sources.title: Gemma 3 12B IT official model repository
sources.evidence: Exact instruction-tuned repository google/gemma-3-12b-it, Gemma license, text/image-to-text model, and downloadable weights subject to accepting Google terms. The public card is accessible; raw files require authenticated acceptance. Reopened October 27, 2026: the exact IT card remains accessible and identifies the same multimodal 12B model; it does not separately define an active count.

sources.title: Introducing Gemma 3: The Developer Guide
sources.evidence: Contemporaneous March 12, 2025 announcement explicitly introduces 1B, 4B, 12B and 27B pretrained and instruction-tuned models, vision-language inputs, text output, 128K context, multilingual support and function calling.

sources.title: Gemma 3 model card
sources.evidence: Identifies Google authorship and open pretrained/instruction-tuned weights. Explicitly assigns text/image input, text output, and a shared 128K input-plus-output context to the 12B model; describes general reasoning ability without classifying a dedicated reasoning mode. Fresh October 27 full-card review confirms exact 12B IT/PT comparison columns without an activated-parameter count.

sources.title: Gemma 3 Technical Report
sources.evidence: Dated March 12, 2025. Section 2 establishes decoder-only Transformer, GQA, RMSNorm and QK-norm, with five local attention layers per global layer. Table 1 labels 12B components at rounded precision: 417M vision, 1,012M embedding and 10,759M non-embedding. Vision encoder is a pretrained SigLIP ViT frozen during Gemma training; it remains part of the model parameter total. Fresh October 27 review of the original complete report and parameter table confirms those are component sizes, not an active-per-token definition. Teacher distillation is a training method and does not replace the released student size with a teacher count.

sources.title: Pinned official repository metadata
sources.evidence: For the exact IT checkpoint revision, safetensors.parameters.BF16 and safetensors.total both equal 12,187,325,040. Architecture is Gemma3ForConditionalGeneration. This is repository metadata, not a direct tensor-header inspection; all reported stored values are BF16. Fresh October 27 request to the same pinned revision again returned BF16 and total 12,187,325,040; no weights were downloaded or tensor census repeated.

sources.title: Google Gemma PyTorch 12B configuration
sources.evidence: get_config_for_12b defines 48 layers, hidden size 3840, MLP width 15360, 16 query heads, 8 KV heads, head dimension 256, 1024 local window, 131072 maximum context and a SigLIP vision encoder. This original Google implementation uses 262144 vocabulary entries; the Hugging Face implementation uses padded 262208 entries.

sources.title: Google SigLIP vision configuration
sources.evidence: Gemma vision encoder has 27 layers, width 1152, MLP width 4304, patch size 14, 3 image channels, attention/projection biases and LayerNorm parameters.

sources.title: Gemma 3 Transformers configuration
sources.evidence: Gemma3TextConfig defaults include vocab_size 262208, head_dim 256, max_position_embeddings 131072 and tied word embeddings. Confirms library-specific padded vocabulary convention used to reconcile the exact Hub aggregate, rather than substituting the Google implementation vocabulary.

sources.title: Gemma 3 Transformers implementation
sources.evidence: Defines dense attention/MLP layers, four per-layer RMSNorm vectors and query/key head norms. LM head is tied to token embeddings; RoPE inverse frequencies are nonpersistent buffers. Multimodal projector has a 1152 by 3840 learned projection and 1152-element RMSNorm. Used for analytical reconciliation, without loading weights.

sources.title: SigLIP Transformers implementation
sources.evidence: Vision model defines convolutional patch embedding, learned position embedding, dense Transformer weights/biases and LayerNorm. Position IDs are nonpersistent buffers. Together with the Google vision dimensions, yields 416,866,032 parameters for the unpooled vision tower; including a SigLIP pooling head would not match the exact repository aggregate.

sources.title: Google ADK Gemma 3 tool integration
sources.evidence: Explicitly recommends gemma-3-12b-it and gemma-3-27b-it for agentic use. GemmaFunctionCallingMixin supplies function calling through text-prompt declarations and parsing model output, and explicitly distinguishes this from native function calling, which Gemma 3 lacks.

sources.title: Gemma Terms of Use
sources.evidence: Custom Gemma Terms of Use govern the Gemma 3 weights; the official repository identifies the license as gemma.

sources.title: Gemma releases
sources.evidence: Current release chronology says March 10, 2025 for Gemma 3 and ShieldGemma 2. This conflicts with the contemporaneous March 12 announcement and dated technical report; preserved as a documented conflict, not used to silently backdate the model.

sources.title: Official repository file metadata
sources.evidence: Lists five safetensors shards and the config/index with a March 12, 2025 initial squash commit; all weight shard last-commit dates are March 12. Repository creation date is not used as public release evidence.

sources.title: Official checkpoint index access attempt
sources.evidence: Raw config and index requests and a range request for the first shard header returned HTTP 401. No raw weight header or complete shard was downloaded.

sources.title: Pinned Gemma 3 checkpoint conversion implementation
sources.evidence: The exact 12B conversion configuration defines 3840 width, 48 layers, 16 query/8 KV heads, and a 27-layer SigLIP tower with pooling head disabled. Conversion appends 64 statistically initialized embedding rows and increments vocabulary from 262144 to 262208. These add 245760 checkpoint parameters; they are conversion-created entries, not original trained embedding rows.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report, Table 18
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 inspection of the original report and exact HTML table S4.T18. The Gemma-3-12B-IT column explicitly labels architecture Dense, Activated Params 12B and Total Params 12B. Section 4.6 identifies this exact instruction-tuned model as a non-reasoning baseline in the authors’ text evaluations. This is the Qwen team’s original rounded comparative counting convention, not a Google disclosure, a tensor-level census, or a claim that all multimodal weights execute for every generated token. The table does not separately assign its rounded active count to a named component.

sources.title: Gemma 4 Technical Report
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 later-disclosure check of model architecture, parameter tables and Gemma 3 comparisons. The explicit active counts concern the new 26B-A4B MoE model; dense figures and Gemma 3 27B comparisons do not supply a new active count for Gemma 3 12B IT. No successor-model number is transferred to this record.

sources.title: Gemma 3 12B hardware and model specifications
sources.evidence: Fresh exact-model search led to a page assigning both total and active 12.187B and linking the general official Hub page. Opened October 27; the linked Google card and pinned metadata establish total size, not that precise active count. This aggregate is not used to replace the separately labeled nominal Qwen benchmark count.

name.note: Official exact 12B instruction-tuned variant, not pretrained, QAT, or a community fine-tune.

developer.note: Google DeepMind authorship; preserves the catalog developer identity Google.

family.note: Gemma 3 is part of the Gemma family.

release_date.note: Contemporaneous Google announcement explicitly releases the 12B IT variant on March 12; dated report and initial weight-file commit corroborate it. The current release chronology says March 10, an unresolved documentation conflict; March 12 is the stronger public-launch evidence.

open_weights.note: Official pretrained and instruction-tuned weights are distributed under the Gemma terms. Acceptance gating does not make the weights closed.

license.note: Custom Gemma Terms of Use, identified by the official repository as gemma.

parameters_b.note: Exact official Hub BF16 aggregate reconciles to 12,187,325,040 unique model parameter elements: language 11,766,034,176 + vision 416,866,032 + projector/norm 4,424,832. Language count = 262208*3840 + 48*(2*3840*16*256 + 2*3840*8*256 + 3*3840*15360 + 4*3840 + 2*256) + 3840. Tied embedding/output weight counted once; includes pretrained frozen vision weights. The analytical count excludes nonpersistent RoPE/position buffers; BF16 aggregation contains no quantized packing or scale category. Direct official config/index/header access was gated, so tensor names/shapes were not independently enumerated. Padded HF vocabulary and omission of the SigLIP pooling head are reconciled with the aggregate using implementation code; no assertion of header-level verification is made. The 12B name and report component table are nominal/rounded. The exact pinned converter confirms the padded vocabulary and no-pooling vision configuration. The count includes 245760 conversion-created embedding entries; the original pre-conversion implementation total is 12187079280. Fresh October 27 metadata recheck confirms the same exact total. The original nominal 12B remains supported; no new weight download or repeated tensor census was needed.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal 12B activated parameters under the Qwen team’s original text-benchmark convention, explicitly labeled for the exact Gemma-3-12B-IT column in Table 18. This verifies that published comparative value, not a Google disclosure or an exact modality-dependent per-token census. It is not obtained by copying the precise 12.18732504B total or the non-embedding subtotal. The source does not decompose its rounded active figure by component, so no language-only scope is invented; vision participation varies with image input. Fresh original/later Google checks supply no finer active definition. The secondary 12.187B active claim is not adopted.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only Transformer language model with GQA and 5:1 local/global attention, plus a SigLIP vision Transformer and multimodal projector; no routed experts in this architecture.

context_window.note: Google configuration gives 131072 positions; official card describes the 12B total input/output context as 128K, with output capacity reduced by input tokens.

modalities.note: Native documented modalities are text and images in, text out. Video described in launch material is processed via image frames, not a separate native video encoder.

reasoning.note: Sources document improved general reasoning and reasoning-focused training, but do not establish the catalog reasoning feature as true or false. Clear the unsupported baseline false instead of interpreting ordinary reasoning ability as a dedicated thinking feature.

tool_call.note: Google launch asserts function-calling support; Google ADK specifically recommends this 12B IT variant for agentic use and implements prompted function declarations plus parsed text responses. This flag indicates that supported capability, not native tool-call tokens or a native structured API protocol.

description.value: Google's instruction-tuned Gemma 3 model for multilingual text generation and image understanding.
description.note: Plain description supported for this exact instruction-tuned multimodal variant.

patch.description: Google's instruction-tuned Gemma 3 model for multilingual text generation and image understanding.
patch.notes: Total comprises 11.766034176B language, 0.416866032B vision and 0.004424832B projector parameters, including 245,760 Hugging Face conversion entries. Active 12B follows the Qwen team’s nominal text-benchmark convention, not a Google per-token specification; vision participation depends on image input. Pinned metadata and implementation agree; raw headers were gated. Function calling uses prompting and output parsing. The March 12 launch conflicts with a later release log saying March 10.

sources.label: Qwen3 technical report — exact Gemma 3 12B IT active-size comparison

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit preserves the freshly reconfirmed exact 12.18732504B total and recovers nominal 12B active from Qwen’s original Table 18 for the exact Gemma 3 12B IT model. The counting convention is explicitly attributed to the Qwen research team; Google’s original report and later comparisons do not define a finer per-token count. No component scope is invented, no weights are downloaded and no tensor census is repeated. All unrelated assessments and the accepted component breakdown are preserved.
